newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: New Zealand shares close firmer on moderate volume.
newsitem.headline: New Zealand shares close firmer on moderate volume.

text.p: New Zealand share prices improved in late Thursday trade to close off their intraday lows as buyers took advantage of soft valuations, brokers said.
"Buying came into the leaders in the afternoon and it picked up very considerably," said Don Turkington at Cavill White.
The NZSE-40 Capital Index ended 9.73 points stronger at 2,310.72 after a sluggish start to the session.

Fletcher Energy stood out as the star performer, leaping 12 cents to $4.65. This morning the company said it had encountered gas shows at its Perdana Deep-1 well in Brunei, as well as improved gas flows at its Mangahewa-2 well in Taranaki.

Brierley Investments, up two cents at $1.36, topped the turnover table with 4.25 million shares traded. Brokers said there was speculation that BIL may be about to sell one of its assets, possibly the Weeks Bass Strait Royalty in Australia.

Telecom, after encountering early weakness, found support later in the day to end just a cent down at $6.62. The market leader's annual profit released on Wenesday was disappointing, although brokers said much of the bad news had been expected.
Air New Zealand "B" shares gained five cents to $4.32. The airline today sealed its alliance with United Airlines with the first flight under their code-sharing arrangement.
